WITH cpi AS (
  SELECT a."ARTregID" AS art_id,
         ((r."HIST_sign" + (r.rating_profile->>'research_score')::numeric + (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric)
          * (10 - CASE a.conserve_status WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 END)) / 30.0 AS cpi
  FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
  JOIN "ArtifactRatings" r ON r."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
), erf AS (
  SELECT s."ART_link" AS art_id,
         AVG(CASE v.val WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END) AS erf
  FROM "SensitivityData" s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
    (s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'light'),
    (s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'temperature'),
    (s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity'),
    (s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'vibration'),
    (s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'pollutants')) v(val)
  GROUP BY s."ART_link"
)
SELECT MAX(c.cpi * e.erf) AS max_avs
FROM cpi c
JOIN erf e ON e.art_id = c.art_id
note: ERF is the average of the five 'environment' sensitivities (light, temperature, humidity, vibration, pollutants), with nulls ignored.

WITH r AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "readTS")::int AS yr, "TEMPc" AS t
  FROM "EnvironmentalReadingsCore"
  WHERE "readTS" >= '2023-01-01' AND "readTS" < '2026-01-01' AND "TEMPc" IS NOT NULL
), y AS (
  SELECT yr, AVG(t) AS avg_t FROM r GROUP BY yr
)
SELECT y.yr AS year, ROUND(y.avg_t, 2) AS avg_temperature,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ABS(r.t - y.avg_t) > 0 AND ABS(r.t - y.avg_t) <= 4) AS anomaly_count
FROM y
JOIN r ON r.yr = y.yr
GROUP BY y.yr, y.avg_t
ORDER BY y.yr
note: Each reading is treated as a daily reading, and deviation means the absolute difference from the year's average. Readings exist only for 2024-2025.

WITH cur AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.art_exam) c.art_exam, e."RH"
  FROM "ConditionAssessments" c
  JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON e.case_link = c.case_exam
  WHERE e."RH" IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY c.art_exam, c.assess_date DESC NULLS LAST, e."readTS" DESC
)
SELECT a."ARTregID" AS registry_number, a.art_title, a."MatKind" AS material_type,
       s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity' AS humidity_sensitivity,
       CASE WHEN (s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity' = 'High' AND cur."RH" > 55)
              OR (s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity' = 'Medium' AND cur."RH" > 60)
            THEN 'Over Exposure' ELSE 'Within Limits' END AS exposure_status
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
JOIN "SensitivityData" s ON s."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
LEFT JOIN cur ON cur.art_exam = a."ARTregID"
WHERE s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity' IN ('Medium', 'High')
ORDER BY a."ARTregID"
note: The knowledge base defines only one set of humidity thresholds (High <=55% RH, Medium <=60% RH). I used those, since nothing defines a 'secondary, more cautious' threshold.

SELECT a."ARTregID" AS artifact_id, a.art_title, ra.risk_level, r."HIST_sign" AS historical_significance, (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::int AS cultural_score
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
JOIN "RiskAssessments" ra ON ra.art_concern = a."ARTregID"
JOIN "ArtifactRatings" r ON r."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
WHERE ra.risk_level IN ('High', 'Medium')
  AND r."HIST_sign" > 8
  AND (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::int > 20

SELECT a."DYNASTY" AS dynasty,
       ((r."HIST_sign" + (r.rating_profile->>'research_score')::numeric + (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric)
        * (10 - CASE a.conserve_status WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 END)) / 30.0 AS cpi_score,
       m.budget_alloc,
       m.budget_stat
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
JOIN "ArtifactRatings" r ON r."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
LEFT JOIN "ConditionAssessments" c ON c.art_exam = a."ARTregID"
LEFT JOIN "LightAndRadiationReadings" l ON l.rad_id = c.light_link
LEFT JOIN "ConservationAndMaintenance" m ON m.monitor_link = l.env_link
WHERE a."DYNASTY" IS NOT NULL

WITH erf AS (
  SELECT s."ART_link" AS art_id,
         AVG(CASE v.val WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END) AS erf_score
  FROM "SensitivityData" s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
    (s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'light'),
    (s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'temperature'),
    (s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity'),
    (s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'vibration'),
    (s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'pollutants')) v(val)
  GROUP BY s."ART_link"
), highs AS (
  SELECT s."ART_link" AS art_id, jsonb_object_agg(leaf.key, leaf.value) AS high_sensitivities
  FROM "SensitivityData" s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(s.env_handling_sensitivity) grp
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(grp.value) = 'object' THEN grp.value ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) leaf
  WHERE leaf.value = 'High'
  GROUP BY s."ART_link"
)
SELECT a."ARTregID" AS artifact_id, a.art_title, e.erf_score, h.high_sensitivities
FROM erf e
JOIN "ArtifactsCore" a ON a."ARTregID" = e.art_id
LEFT JOIN highs h ON h.art_id = e.art_id
WHERE e.erf_score > 4
ORDER BY e.erf_score DESC

WITH cpi AS (
  SELECT a."ARTregID" AS artifact_id, a.art_title, a."DYNASTY" AS dynasty,
         ((r."HIST_sign" + (r.rating_profile->>'research_score')::numeric + (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric)
          * (10 - CASE a.conserve_status WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 END)) / 30.0 AS cpi_score
  FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
  JOIN "ArtifactRatings" r ON r."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
  WHERE a."DYNASTY" IN ('Ming', 'Qing')
)
SELECT artifact_id, art_title, dynasty, cpi_score,
       CASE WHEN cpi_score > 7 THEN 'High Priority' WHEN cpi_score > 4 THEN 'Medium Priority' WHEN cpi_score <= 4 THEN 'Low Priority' END AS priority_level
FROM cpi
ORDER BY cpi_score DESC NULLS LAST

WITH cur AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.art_exam) c.art_exam, e."TEMPc", e."RH"
  FROM "ConditionAssessments" c
  JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON e.case_link = c.case_exam
  ORDER BY c.art_exam, c.assess_date DESC NULLS LAST, e."readTS" DESC
), sens AS (
  SELECT s."ART_link" AS art_id,
         AVG(CASE v.val WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END) AS erf,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE v.val = 'High') AS high_count
  FROM "SensitivityData" s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
    (s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'light'),
    (s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'temperature'),
    (s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity'),
    (s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'vibration'),
    (s.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'pollutants')) v(val)
  GROUP BY s."ART_link"
)
SELECT a."ARTregID" AS artifact_id, a.art_title,
       cur."TEMPc" AS current_temperature, cur."RH" AS current_humidity,
       COALESCE(sens.high_count, 0) AS high_sensitivity_count,
       CASE WHEN (a."ageYears" * sens.erf * POWER(cur."RH" - 50, 2) * cur."TEMPc") / 100000.0 > 5
             AND COALESCE(sens.high_count, 0) >= 2 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS accelerated_deterioration
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
LEFT JOIN cur ON cur.art_exam = a."ARTregID"
LEFT JOIN sens ON sens.art_id = a."ARTregID"
ORDER BY a."ARTregID"

SELECT DISTINCT e.case_link AS showcase_id
FROM "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e
WHERE e.case_link IS NOT NULL AND (e."tempVar24" > 1 OR e."RHvar" > 3)
ORDER BY e.case_link

SELECT DISTINCT s."caseID" AS showcase_id
FROM "Showcases" s
LEFT JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON e.case_link = s."caseID"
WHERE (10 - ((e."tempVar24" + e."RHvar" / 5.0 + (s.case_environment_profile->'physical_state'->>'leak_rate_per_day')::numeric) / 3.0)) < 5
   OR ((CASE WHEN s.case_environment_profile->'physical_state'->>'seal_state' = 'Poor' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
     + (CASE WHEN s.case_environment_profile->'maintenance'->>'maint_status' = 'Overdue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
     + (CASE WHEN s.case_environment_profile->'maintenance'->>'filter_status' = 'Replace Now' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
     + (CASE WHEN s.case_environment_profile->'maintenance'->>'silica_status' = 'Replace Now' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) >= 3
ORDER BY s."caseID"
